user.title: Welcome to SlotSentry
user.description:
SlotSentry gives you a single place to manage PIN codes across all your Z-Wave locks.

This wizard will discover your locks, configure code lengths, optionally set up a keypad lockout trigger, and choose whether to enable Secure Mode.

locks.title: Select Z-Wave Locks
locks.description: Select all locks you want SlotSentry to manage. The number of available slots will be determined by the lock with the smallest capacity.

code_length.title: Code Length Mode
code_length.description:
{discovery_notice}

If your locks use different PIN lengths (e.g. some are 4-digit and others are 6-digit), turn on the toggle below to set separate short and long lengths.

code_length_single.title: Code Length
code_length_single.description: Set the PIN code length that all locks will use.

code_length_dual.title: Short & Long Code Lengths
code_length_dual.description: Set the short and long PIN code lengths. Short must be less than long.

lockout.title: Keypad Lockout — Optional
lockout.description:
SlotSentry can disable lock keypads when a trigger entity reaches one or more target states (e.g. when your alarm is armed).

Select the trigger entity, then choose which states activate the lockout. You can select multiple states or type custom values.

data.lockout_target_states: Target states (lockout activates when entity matches any)

secure_mode.title: Secure Mode — Optional
secure_mode.description:
When Secure Mode is enabled, all stored PIN codes are encrypted at rest. You will be prompted to set a password the first time you open the SlotSentry panel.

Secure Mode can also be enabled or disabled later via Reconfigure.

confirm.title: Review & Confirm

error.short_gte_long: Short code length must be less than long code length.
error.no_lockout_locks: At least one lock must participate in lockout.
error.no_lockout_states: Select at least one target state when lockout is enabled.
